decision.reason: [ev-916bf6975201] is a single changelog line. It says the Helm chart now lets you configure the API version of the PodLog CRD, so the change type (added) is clear. It doesn't name the Helm values key, its default, or the API versions allowed, and it doesn't say whether the default PodLog apiVersion that gets rendered has changed. It only points to PR #10812 and commit d1dee91, so we can't write down the subject or an applicability condition. We need the values.yaml or template diff from that commit, or the PR description.
